# ReqEmbed v0.3.5 - Table of Contents

> Req plugin to fetch oEmbed resources and a Phoenix Component to embed rich content.

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://req-embed.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [Content Security Policy](https://req-embed.hexdocs.pm/csp.md)

## Modules

- [ReqEmbed](https://req-embed.hexdocs.pm/ReqEmbed.md): 
- [ReqEmbed.Link](https://req-embed.hexdocs.pm/ReqEmbed.Link.md): Generic embed data type.
- [ReqEmbed.Photo](https://req-embed.hexdocs.pm/ReqEmbed.Photo.md): The photo type used to represent static photos.
- [ReqEmbed.Rich](https://req-embed.hexdocs.pm/ReqEmbed.Rich.md): The rich type used for rich HTML content that does not fall under one of the other categories.
- [ReqEmbed.Video](https://req-embed.hexdocs.pm/ReqEmbed.Video.md): The video type used to represent playable videos.
